login.title: Test login
login.description: Ask your supervisor for the password.
login.notSet: No password has been set yet. Contact the administrator.

identify.title: Select your name
identify.description: If your name is not listed, choose “Other”.
identify.newNameHint: You are added as a candidate. The administrator will check the name.

home.pdfHelp: If the PDF does not display (some phones show only page 1), open it in a new tab.
home.testInfo: {count} questions drawn at random. {required} correct answers to pass.
home.notReady: This test is not available yet. Contact the administrator.
home.allDoneBody: The study material is still available below.

test.autosaveFailed: Could not save. Your answers are still on this page; check your connection.

result.title: Result
result.failedHint: Review the answers below and the study material, then retake the test.

errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do that.
errors.crossSite: The request was blocked for security reasons. Reload the page and try again.
errors.materialNotFound: No study material has been uploaded for this test.
errors.bankNotFound: There is no question bank for this test yet.
errors.attemptNotFound: That test attempt was not found.
errors.invalidInput: Some of the entered data is not valid ({field}).
errors.badJson: The data could not be read.
errors.invalidName: A name must be 1 to {max} characters long and must not contain control characters.
errors.memberNameExists: This name is already in the list. Please choose it from the list.
errors.tooManyNames: Too many names at once (at most {max}).
errors.passwordNotSet: The password has not been set yet.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many wrong attempts. Please wait {retryAfterSec} seconds and try again.
errors.invalidPassword: The password must be {min} to {max} characters long.
errors.passwordManagedByEnv: This password is set by an environment variable and cannot be changed here.
errors.wrongCurrentPassword: The current password is not correct.
errors.notPdf: This file is not a PDF.
errors.fileTooLarge: The file is larger than {maxMb} MB.
errors.unsupportedContentType: The request has an unsupported format.
errors.wrongRole: This test is not for your current role.
errors.testNotReady: This test is not available yet.
errors.attemptClosed: This test has already been handed in.
errors.attemptNotFinished: This test attempt is not finished yet.
errors.invalidAnswers: The answers could not be read. Reload the page.
errors.reviewNotConfirmed: Please confirm that a person has checked the questions.
errors.bankInvalid: The question bank has problems. See the list below.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on the server. Please try again.
errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection.

json.syntax: The text is not valid JSON ({message}).

root.invalid: The JSON must be an object with a “questions” list.
root.array: The file is a plain list of questions (no “meta” information).

schema.unsupported: This file format version ({version}) is not supported.

input.fenceStripped: The Markdown code fence around the JSON was removed.
input.extraTextIgnored: Text before or after the JSON was ignored. Check that nothing important was cut off.

question.notObject: This entry is not a question object.
question.textTooLong: The question text is longer than {max} characters.
question.textShort: The question text is very short.
question.choicesMissing: The list of choices is missing.
question.choiceEmpty: Choice {choice} is empty or not text.
question.choicesNotExact: Exactly {expected} choices are needed (this question has {count}).
question.refersToChoices: The question refers to other choices by letter; choices are shuffled, so this will be confusing.
question.noteInvalid: “{field}” must be text of at most {max} characters.

choice.allOfTheAbove: Choice {choice} looks like “all of the above”, which does not work when choices are shuffled.
choice.refersToOthers: Choice {choice} refers to other choices by letter; choices are shuffled, so this will be confusing.

answer.isNumber: The answer is the number {value}. Use the letter of the correct choice (A, B, C, …); numbers are not accepted because counting from 0 or 1 is ambiguous.
answer.invalid: The answer “{value}” is not a letter such as A, B, C.
answer.outOfRange: The answer {letter} does not exist: the question has only {count} choices.

bank.tooFew: There are {count} questions, but at least {required} are needed to draw one test.
bank.sizeDiffers: There are {count} questions; {expected} are expected. The test still works.
bank.duplicateId: The id “{id}” is used by several questions ({questions}).
bank.answerSkew: {percent}% of the correct answers are “{letter}”. AIs often favour one letter; choices are shuffled during the test, but check the answers again.

issues.omitted: …and {count} more problems of the same kind ({of}).

login.title: Admin login
login.hint: The password is printed once in the terminal when the app first starts.

dashboard.title: Progress
dashboard.selfRegistered_one: {count} person registered their own name. Check it.
dashboard.selfRegistered_other: {count} people registered their own names. Check them.
dashboard.noMembers: No members yet. Add them under Members.

members.title: Members
members.name: Name
members.bulkHelp: One name per line. Existing names are skipped.
members.selfRegisteredHelp: This name was self-registered. Saving marks it as checked.
members.deleteConfirm: Delete {name}? All of their results are deleted too. This cannot be undone.
members.roleHelp: Roles go up automatically when a test is passed. You can also change them here.

tests.title: Tests
tests.intro: Upload the PDF, let an AI draft questions, import them, and save after a person has checked them.

material.title: Study material (PDF)
material.help: Shown to participants before the test.

prompt.title: 1. Draft questions with an AI
prompt.help: Attach the PDF in an AI chat (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.), paste this prompt and save the JSON it returns. This app does not connect to any AI.
prompt.warning: AI output can contain invented facts or wrong answers. A person must check every question against the PDF before use.
prompt.info: Asks for {count} questions with {choices} choices each.
prompt.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select the text and copy it manually.

bank.importHelp: Upload or paste the JSON and check it. Nothing is saved here; valid questions open in step 3.
bank.resultWarnings: {count} warnings (the file can still be used)
bank.reviewConfirm: A person has checked every question and answer against the study material.
bank.draftExists: This replaces the unsaved questions open in step 3.
bank.draftBanner: Not saved yet. Check and edit below, tick the confirmation, then save.
bank.replaceWarning: Replaces the current bank ({count} questions). Past results are not affected.
bank.notEnough: A test needs at least {required} questions.

settings.title: Settings
settings.changed: Password changed. Other admin sessions were logged out.
settings.managedByEnv: Set by the ADMIN_PASSWORD environment variable; cannot be changed here.
settings.participantHelp: One shared password for everyone who takes the tests. Share it with your team.
settings.participantNotSet: Not set. Nobody can log in to the test screen yet.
settings.participantSet: Set. It cannot be shown again; set a new one if it is forgotten.
settings.participantManagedByEnv: Set by the PARTICIPANT_PASSWORD environment variable; cannot be changed here.
settings.logsOut: Changing it logs out everyone on the test screen.
settings.dataBody: Names, roles, results, questions and PDFs are stored in the data folder of the computer running this app. Nothing is sent elsewhere.
